captions.instagram:
Streamed GTA VI all month? 🎮 No 1099 from the platform doesn't mean no tax.

Myth: "No 1099 means it isn't taxable."
Fact: you report all of it, form or no form. That includes tips, subs, bits, ad share and sponsor money.

✔️ Gear or game codes you get in exchange for a review can count as income too.
✔️ Net $400 or more from self-employment? You file, and self-employment tax applies.
✔️ Keep receipts for your stream costs before Dec 31.

Comment STREAM with your creator tax question.

Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. Sources: IRS gig economy pages. General information, not advice for your situation.
captions.youtube_title: No 1099 From Twitch or YouTube? Your Stream Money Still Counts
captions.youtube_description: Myth: no 1099 from the platform means the money isn't taxable. Fact: income from gig and creator work must be reported even if no 1099-K, 1099-MISC or W-2 shows it, and even if it was paid in property or goods. If net self-employment earnings are $400 or more, you file and self-employment tax applies (Schedule SE). Sources: IRS 'All income is taxable' and 'Manage taxes for your gig work'. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. General information, not advice for your situation.
